plain.li: [trait:Greedy] I'd like "{WISH}" before somebody else gets something first.
[trait:Jealous] Others have been given things since I asked for "{WISH}". I've noticed.
[trait:Nervous] Sorry to ask again about "{WISH}". I keep worrying it was forgotten.
[trait:Ascetic] I don't ask for much. I asked for "{WISH}", and I'm still waiting.
[child] Is "{WISH}" happening yet? I asked ages ago.
[old] At my age I can't wait forever for "{WISH}".
[doubtful] I'm starting to wonder whether "{WISH}" was ever going to happen.
[trusting] I'm sure you haven't forgotten "{WISH}". I'm only reminding you.
[repeat] I asked for "{WISH}" once before and it came to nothing, so I'm asking early this time.
[trait:Volatile] One more day without "{WISH}" and I won't be responsible for what I say.
[bitter] Ask, wait, nothing. "{WISH}" was never going to happen, was it?
[child] You said maybe about "{WISH}". Maybe means yes, right?
[old] I'm too old to keep asking for "{WISH}". This is the last time.
[trait:Greedy] {PAWN_nameDef} admires it, then asks whether there's any chance of a second one.
[trait:Gourmand] {PAWN_nameDef} celebrates with an extra helping at supper.
[trait:Recluse] {PAWN_nameDef} waits until everyone has gone before going to look at it properly.
[trait:Pessimist|trait:Depressive] {PAWN_nameDef} keeps glancing at it, as though it might disappear.
[trait:NightOwl] {PAWN_nameDef} is still up admiring it long after everyone else is asleep.
[winter] {PAWN_nameDef} stamps the snow off {PAWN_possessive} boots, takes one look, and grins.
[summer] {PAWN_nameDef} wipes the sweat from {PAWN_possessive} face and stands there smiling at it.
[afterraid] After the fighting, it's the first thing {PAWN_nameDef} has smiled at in days.
[grieving] For the first time since the loss, {PAWN_nameDef} looks something like glad.
[trusting] {PAWN_nameDef} had no doubt it would happen, and still looks delighted.
[doubtful] {PAWN_nameDef} looks at it, then at the council, and the doubt goes out of {PAWN_possessive} face.
